author: Michael Larabel
description: Version 2.43 of the GNU C Library "glibc" was released on Friday evening as the newest half-year feature update. This is a very feature packaged update and even managed to be released ahead of the 1 February release plan...
title: GNU C Library 2.43 Released With More C23 Features, mseal & openat2 Functions

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following the release of Wine 11.0 stable just under two weeks ago, Wine 11.1 is now available as the first of the bi-weekly development snapshots for Wine in leading toward the Wine 12.0 release next January...
title: Wine 11.1 Released In Kicking Off The New Development Cycle

author: Michael Larabel
description: Similar to the new Intel IPU 7.5 firmware upstreamed for Panther Lake this week, Cirrus has upstreamed their CS42L45 codec firmware for upcoming Dell and Lenovo laptops making use of this audio codec...
title: Firmware Upstreamed For Audio Support With Upcoming Dell & Lenovo Panther Lake Laptops

author: Michael Larabel
description: Queued into tip/tip.git's "sched/urgent" Git branch today is a patch to disable the kernel scheduler's NEXT_BUDDY functionality that was re-implemented back during the Linux 6.19 merge window. It turns out to cause some performance regressions that have yet to be otherwise addressed...
title: Linux 6.19 Scheduler Feature Being Disabled Due To Performance Regressions

author: Michael Larabel
description: Fraunhofer HHI this week released a new version of VVenC, their open-source H.266 video encoder. Among the changes this release are more performance optimizations for ARM and I have run some comparison benchmarks using a NVIDIA GB10 SoC with the Dell Pro Max GB10...
title: VVenC H.266 Encoder Rolls Out More ARM Optimizations For Nice Performance Gains

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to the release today of Vulkan 1.4.340 with the new descriptor heap "VK_EXT_descriptor_heap" extension and three other new extensions, The Khronos Group's Vulkan Working Group has also published the Vulkan Roadmap 2026 Milestone...
title: Vulkan Roadmap 2026 Milestone: Variable Rate Shading, Host Image Copies & More

author: Michael Larabel
description: AMD today released a new version of Ryzen AI Software, the user-space packages for Microsoft Windows and Linux for making use of the Ryzen AI NPUs for various AI software tasks like Stable Diffusion, ONNX, and more...
title: AMD Ryzen AI Software 1.7 Released For Improved Performance On NPUs, New Model Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: GNU Guix 1.5 is out today as the latest major release for this platform built around its functional package manager. This is a big upgrade with it having been three years since the GNU Guix 1.4 release...
title: GNU Guix 1.5 Released With RISC-V Support, Experimental x86_64 GNU Hurd Kernel

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged today for the Linux 6.19 Git kernel and then in turn for back-porting to prior Linux kernel series is making the x86 page fault handling code disable interrupts properly. Since 2020 it turns out the handling was subtly wrong but now corrected by Intel...
title: Linux Lands Fix For Its "Subtly Wrong" Page Fault Handling Code For The Past 5 Years

author: Michael Larabel
description: Zlib-rs is the effort out of the Trifecta Tech Foundation to provide a Zlib compression implementation written in the Rust programming language that can serve as a C dynamic library and Rust crate. The intent here being that zlib-rs is potentially safer than the classic C-based implementation of Zlib...
title: Zlib-rs 0.6 Released With Improved AVX-512 Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Vulkan 1.4.340 is out today as the first significant new Vulkan API update following the end of year holidays. With Vulkan 1.4.340 comes four new extensions worth talking about...
title: Vulkan 1.4.340 Released With Descriptor Heap & Other New Extensions

author: Michael Larabel
description: KMSCON as a KMS/DRM-based virtual console emulator in user-space has been released. KMSCON is one of the leading solutions for potentially replacing the in-kernel Virtual Terminal (VT) implementation...
title: KMSCON 9.3 Released With Mouse Support By Default, Other Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: Servo 0.0.4 is out today as the newest monthly update to this open-source, Rust-based web browser engine. Building off recent Servo embedding API additions, Servo 0.0.4 introduces support for multiple browser windows...
title: Servo 0.0.4 Browser Engine Released & Finally Supporting Multiple Windows
